provenance: Assistant visual review of original frames, existing debug review sheets, and new wrist overlays. Reference withdrawals come from the previous independently stored action intervals. This is exploratory analysis of known clips, not an untouched test set or independent human annotation.

limitations: Two real withdrawals, same fixed camera and cashier: insufficient to estimate generalization.
No real empty-output touches available; false-positive rate for this hard negative is unmeasured.
No manual dense keypoint ground truth; wrist localization precision/recall and ownership accuracy cannot be inferred from event counts.
Unknown raw wrist observations include reflections and ambiguous or short pose tracks; they are not unique people or action events.

The wrist point itself never enters the physical output core in the two true withdrawals. The explicit palm/wrist allowance is essential, so these are proximity observations rather than 3D contact evidence.
Cash detector errors and nearby unrelated cash can still support a wrong hypothesis in other videos.
15-fps pose observations versus approximately 4.27-fps previous motion analysis: gains cannot be attributed separately to detector and sampling density without an ablation.
cash_new_min_gap_sec in frozen protocol is unused metadata; actual cash novelty gate rejects cash linked to this hand in the 0.5 seconds before entry.
recommended_next_step: Collect short same-camera empty-output touches, button presses, near-output table reaches, and visits while already holding cash/ID. Re-run the frozen diagnostic before integrating an optional hand-counter observation source. Do not create MONEY_FROM_COUNTER from touch alone.
